page.layout: One printed block: a bookplate label in the centre of the page, four lines of print with a handwritten shelf number beneath. Stamps, shelf marks and the digitiser's notice at the top and bottom right are outside the printed text and are left out.
page.notes: The label is a printed ex libris bookplate. The last line "23. 9" is handwritten, not printed, and is given here only because it sits inside the label. The "Rom" line ends in a worn letter that may be "e" or "r". The library stamps (NAZIONALE / ROMA, 13 K 52), the manuscript pencil shelf mark "11.3.22" and the "Digitized by Google" notice are not transcribed.
